_help: Edit texts here, then run: python generar_html.py. {company_name} is replaced with the cleaned company name. If you change a text a lot, add it as a NEW version (e.g. V4) and put it in 'rotation' instead of editing an old one, so stats stay honest.

messages.V0: Hi, I know you probably get a lot of calls, so I figured a text was better. I came across {company_name} and wanted to reach out about truck dispatching services. My name's Fernando, I'm an independent dispatcher. If you're not interested, no worries at all, I won't reach out again. Thanks for your time, God bless you.
